haUrl.title: Home Assistant URL
haUrl.description: The local base URL of your Home Assistant instance.

haToken.title: Long-Lived Access Token
haToken.description: Create one under your Home Assistant profile's 'Long-Lived Access Tokens' section.

updateInterval.title: Polling Fallback Interval (seconds)
updateInterval.description: How often to poll over REST when the WebSocket connection is down.

fanEntity.title: Fan Entity ID
fanEntity.description: The Home Assistant fan entity that supports preset_mode.

autoPreset.title: Auto Preset
autoPreset.description: The preset_mode mapped to HomeKit's AUTO target state (not shown on the slider).

manualPresets.title: Manual Presets (weak → strong)
manualPresets.description: The remaining preset_modes, mapped in order onto the RotationSpeed slider.

airQualityEntity.title: Air Quality Sensor Entity ID
airQualityEntity.description: A sensor reporting a 1 (best) to 4 (worst) clean-air level.

airQualityMapping.title: Air Quality Mapping
airQualityMapping.description: HomeKit AirQuality (1 EXCELLENT – 5 POOR) for clean-air levels 1, 2, 3 and 4 respectively.
